```python
def test_shipped_venue_facts_p22():
    _, _, facts = _t5_shipped()
    v = facts.venues
    assert set(v) == {"kis", "upbit", "bithumb", "coinone", "korbit", "okx"}
    assert v["kis"].sections == ("krx", "us") and v["kis"].quote_by_currency
    assert v["kis"].markets == frozenset() and v["kis"].default_quote is None
    assert v["kis"].settlement == frozenset({"KRW", "USD"})
    assert v["upbit"].markets == frozenset({("BTC", "KRW"), ("USDT", "KRW")})        # KRW-quoted only
    assert v["okx"].markets == frozenset({("BTC", "USDT"), ("BTC", "USDC")})
    assert v["okx"].settlement == frozenset({"USDT", "USDC"}) and v["okx"].default_quote == "USDT"
    for vid in ("upbit", "bithumb", "coinone", "korbit"):
        assert v[vid].settlement == frozenset({"KRW"}) and v[vid].default_quote == "KRW", vid
    for vid in ("upbit", "bithumb", "coinone", "korbit", "okx"):
        assert v[vid].sections == ("crypto",) and not v[vid].quote_by_currency, vid
    assert v["upbit"].deposits == v["okx"].deposits == frozenset({("BTC", "bitcoin", False)})
    for vid in ("kis", "bithumb", "coinone", "korbit"):
        assert v[vid].deposits == frozenset(), vid             # a withdrawal there fails closed
    assert set(_t5_rules.DOMESTIC_EXCHANGES) <= set(v)


def test_shipped_venue_markets_resolve():
    _, imap, facts = _t5_shipped()
    v = facts.venues
    sam, spy = imap.entries[("krx", "005930")], imap.entries[("us", "SPY")]
    btc, usdt = imap.entries[("crypto", "BTC")], imap.entries[("crypto", "USDT")]
    assert v["kis"].is_market(sam, "KRW") and v["kis"].is_market(spy, "USD")
    assert not v["kis"].is_market(spy, "KRW") and not v["kis"].is_market(sam, "USD")
    assert not v["kis"].is_market(btc, "KRW")                      # coins are not in kis's sections
    assert (v["kis"].quote_for(sam), v["kis"].quote_for(spy)) == ("KRW", "USD")
    assert v["upbit"].is_market(btc, "KRW") and v["upbit"].is_market(usdt, "KRW")
    assert not v["upbit"].is_market(btc, "USDT") and v["upbit"].quote_for(btc) == "KRW"
    assert v["okx"].is_market(btc, "USDT") and v["okx"].is_market(btc, "USDC")
    assert not v["okx"].is_market(usdt, "BTC") and v["okx"].quote_for(btc) == "USDT"
    assert imap.lookup(v["kis"].sections, "BTC") is None and imap.lookup(v["upbit"].sections, "SPY") is None
    assert imap.lookup(v["kis"].sections, "252670") is imap.entries[("krx", "252670")]


def test_shipped_sources_are_https_or_repo_paths():
    table, imap, _ = _t5_shipped()
    for r in table.rows:
        assert r.sources and r.research, r.id
        for entry in r.sources:
            assert _t5_ref_ok(entry), (r.id, entry)
        for entry in r.research:
            assert not entry.startswith("https://") and _t5_ref_ok(entry), (r.id, entry)
    for inst in imap.entries.values():
        assert inst.source.startswith("https://") or inst.source == _T5_UNVERIFIED, inst.symbol
    doc = _t5_rules.load_strict(_t5_raw("venues"), "venues")
    for vid, entry in doc["venues"].items():
        assert _t5_ref_ok(entry["source"]) or entry["source"] == _T5_UNVERIFIED, vid


def test_shipped_urls_come_from_the_research():
    """No invented URL: every https URL in the three drafts is exactly a URL of the repo's research notes, so a
    truncated one fails. A new source is recorded in reports/ or research_notes/ before it is cited here."""
    corpus = b"\n".join(p.read_bytes() for d in _T5_RESEARCH_DIRS for p in sorted((_T5_REPO / d).rglob("*.md")))
    known = {u.rstrip(b".,;*") for u in _t5_re.findall(rb"https://[^\s)\]>\"'`|]+", corpus)}
    for kind in _T5_SHIPPED:
        urls = _t5_re.findall(r'https://[^"\s]+', _t5_raw(kind).decode("utf-8"))
        assert urls, kind
        for url in urls:
            assert url.encode("utf-8") in known, (kind, url)
```

### Task 6: Shared model (`core/compliance/model.py`)

**Files:**
- Create: `core/compliance/model.py` (LF, UTF-8, no BOM)
- Modify: `tests/compliance_fixtures.py` (LF; append one block at the end of the file, after `temp_home()`)
- Test: `tests/compliance_model.py` (create; LF)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 1: `tests/compliance_fixtures.temp_home()`; `tests/compliance_acceptance.py` whose `MODULES` already lists
    `"compliance_model"` and `"compliance_gate"` (contract section 3), so no aggregator edit is needed here.
  - Task 4: `core.compliance.rules.approved_state(rules_raw: bytes, instruments_raw: bytes, venues_raw: bytes, *,
    seq: int, history_raws: tuple[bytes, ...] = ()) -> ApprovedState`; the names `RulesTable`, `InstrumentMap`,
    `VenueFacts` (imported under `TYPE_CHECKING` only, so model.py has no runtime dependency on rules.py).
  - Task 5: the shipped drafts `core/compliance/kr_rules.yaml`, `core/compliance/instruments.yaml`,
    `core/odds/venues.yaml`.
  - Test only: `core.ficc.macro_schema.canonical_json(obj) -> str` (exists at `core/ficc/macro_schema.py:303-305`).
- Produces (`core/compliance/model.py`, contract section 5, names unchanged):
  - `ALLOW, ALLOW_EXIT, ACK_REQUIRED, BLOCK = "ALLOW", "ALLOW_EXIT", "ACK_REQUIRED", "BLOCK"`;
    `KST = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("Asia/Seoul")` (built at import).
  - `jsonable(obj)`; `canonical_json(obj) -> str`; `sha256_hex(data: bytes | str) -> str`;
    `iso_utc(moment: datetime) -> str` (ValueError on a naive datetime or a bare date).
  - Frozen, kw_only dataclasses `Intent`, `Exposure`, `Positions`, `ApprovedState` (with `invalid(reason)` and the
    `state_hash` property), `OwnerState` (with `broken(reason, *, head=(0, ""), fingerprint="")` and the `ok`
    property), `SessionState`, `Context`, `Decision`, `Permit`, `Screening`, fields exactly as contract 5.2.
  - `intent_hash(intent: Intent) -> str`; `seal_context(**fields) -> Context`; `is_sealed(ctx) -> bool`.
  - Three precisions on contract 5.2 (no name changes; later tasks rely on them):
    - `Decision.decision_id: str = ""` is **always recomputed** in `__post_init__` as
      `sha256_hex(canonical_json({every other field}))`, so `dataclasses.replace(d, ...)` gives a fresh id and a
      passed id is ignored. Only gate.py builds Decisions.
    - `Decision.date: date | None` (None only when decide() refused an unsealed context).
    - `Context.ctx_hash: str = ""` (default, so a hand-built `Context(...)` is easy to write in a test);
      `seal_context` drops any passed `ctx_hash` and computes it over every other field. `is_sealed(None)` is False.
  - `jsonable` sorts a set by each element's JSON text (mixed element types never raise) and raises ValueError
    when two Mapping keys read the same after conversion (for example `1` and `"1"`).
  - Fixtures appended to `tests/compliance_fixtures.py`:
    `shipped_bytes(kind: str) -> bytes` ("rules" | "instruments" | "venues");
    `approved(rules=None, instruments=None, venues=None, *, seq=3, history=()) -> ApprovedState` (None means the
    shipped draft; `history` is a tuple of raw instrument-map bytes; cached with `functools.lru_cache(typed=True)`,
    so the same bytes and seq give the same object and `seq=True` never shares an entry with `seq=1`: treat it as
    frozen and derive variants with `dataclasses.replace`);
    `ctx(**overrides) -> Context` (sealed; defaults of contract 5.4; `active` defaults to `approved()`);
    `intent(**overrides) -> Intent` (Upbit BTC buy for KRW, multiple 1.0, quantity 0.001, notional 50,000).

**Plan decisions used:** P2 (shared types in a pure stdlib module), P5 (sealed contexts), P18 (`counter_symbol`
defaults to `""`), P19 (`Positions` is caller-supplied).

```python
from datetime import date as _date  # noqa: E402
from pathlib import Path as _Path  # noqa: E402

_REPO = _Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
_SHIPPED = {"rules": _REPO / "core" / "compliance" / "kr_rules.yaml",
            "instruments": _REPO / "core" / "compliance" / "instruments.yaml",
            "venues": _REPO / "core" / "odds" / "venues.yaml"}


def shipped_bytes(kind: str) -> bytes:
    """Bytes of the shipped draft: "rules", "instruments" or "venues"."""
    return _SHIPPED[kind].read_bytes()


@_functools.lru_cache(maxsize=32, typed=True)       # typed: seq=True must not reuse the entry for seq=1
def _approved(rules_raw: bytes, instruments_raw: bytes, venues_raw: bytes, seq: int, history: tuple):
    from core.compliance import rules as R
    return R.approved_state(rules_raw, instruments_raw, venues_raw, seq=seq, history_raws=history)


def approved(rules=None, instruments=None, venues=None, *, seq=3, history=()):
    """rules.approved_state over the given bytes (the shipped drafts by default); cached, so treat it as frozen."""
    return _approved(shipped_bytes("rules") if rules is None else rules,
                     shipped_bytes("instruments") if instruments is None else instruments,
                     shipped_bytes("venues") if venues is None else venues, seq, tuple(history))


def ctx(**overrides):
    """A sealed Context for gate tests (contract 5.4); any field can be overridden."""
    from core.compliance import model as M
    fields = dict(
        date=_date(2026, 10, 23), snapshot=None,
        owner=M.OwnerState(status="OK", head=(10, "a" * 64), caps={"okx_equity_share": 0.10},
                           limits={"total_loss_floor_krw": 21_000.0, "daily_loss_krw": 5_000.0},
                           flags=frozenset({"age_of_majority"}), fingerprint="SHA256:test"),
        code_hash="c" * 64, code_signed=True, session=M.SessionState(session_id="S1", armed=True),
        equity_krw=1_000_000.0, holdings={}, shorts={}, exposure={})
    fields.update(overrides)
    if "active" not in fields:
        fields["active"] = approved()
    return M.seal_context(**fields)


def intent(**overrides):
    """An Upbit BTC buy for KRW, 0.001 BTC at KRW 50,000; any field can be overridden."""
    from core.compliance import model as M
    fields = dict(venue="upbit", symbol="BTC", counter_symbol="KRW", asset="crypto_coin", multiple=1.0,
                  action="buy", quantity=0.001, notional_krw=50_000.0)
    fields.update(overrides)
    return M.Intent(**fields)
```

```python
"""Shared model (Task 6; contract section 5; P2, P5): canonical JSON, hashes, sealed contexts and derived ids.

No network, no clock, no file writes; the shipped drafts are only read, by the ctx() fixture.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import math
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone

from core.compliance import model
from tests import compliance_fixtures as F

_PLAIN = [
    {"b": 1, "a": [1, 2.5, "x"], "c": {"z": None, "y": True}},
    ["한글", "é", -0.0, 1e-7, 10**20, False],
    {"nested": {"k": [{"q": 0.1}, []], "": {}}},
    "text", 3, 2.0, None,
]


def _raises(exc: type[BaseException], fn) -> None:
    """`fn()` must raise `exc`."""
    try:
        fn()
    except exc:
        return
    raise AssertionError(f"did not raise {exc.__name__}")


def test_canonical_json_matches_macro_schema():
    from core.ficc.macro_schema import canonical_json as reference
    for sample in _PLAIN:
        assert model.canonical_json(sample) == reference(sample), sample


def test_jsonable_handles_sets_tuple_keys_dates_and_dataclasses():
    @dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
    class Inner:
        when: date
        tags: frozenset

    @dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
    class Outer:
        inner: Inner
        book: dict

    one = Outer(inner=Inner(when=date(2026, 10, 23), tags=frozenset({"b", "a"})),
                book={("upbit", "BTC"): 0.5, "x": (1, 2)})
    two = Outer(inner=Inner(when=date(2026, 10, 23), tags=frozenset({"a", "b"})),
                book={"x": (1, 2), ("upbit", "BTC"): 0.5})
    assert model.jsonable(one) == {"inner": {"when": "2026-10-23", "tags": ["a", "b"]},
                                   "book": {"upbit|BTC": 0.5, "x": [1, 2]}}
    assert model.canonical_json(one) == model.canonical_json(two)
    assert model.jsonable(frozenset({("BTC", "USDT"), ("BTC", "KRW")})) == [["BTC", "KRW"], ["BTC", "USDT"]]
    assert model.jsonable(frozenset({1, "a"})) == ["a", 1]                  # mixed types sort by their JSON text
    names = [f"s{n:02d}" for n in range(20)]
    assert model.jsonable(frozenset(reversed(names))) == names               # not the set's own (salted) order
    for bad in (math.nan, math.inf, -math.inf):
        _raises(ValueError, lambda: model.jsonable({"x": [bad]}))
        _raises(ValueError, lambda: model.canonical_json(bad))
    _raises(TypeError, lambda: model.canonical_json({"x": object()}))
    _raises(TypeError, lambda: model.canonical_json(b"bytes"))
    _raises(ValueError, lambda: model.jsonable({1: "a", "1": "b"}))        # two keys that read the same


def test_intent_hash_is_stable_and_changes_with_any_field():

    assert model.intent_hash(base) == model.intent_hash(F.intent()) and len(model.intent_hash(base)) == 64
    changes = {"venue": "okx", "symbol": "USDT", "counter_symbol": "USDT", "asset": "us_etp", "multiple": 2.0,
               "action": "sell", "financing": "credit", "quantity": 0.002, "notional_krw": 50_001.0,
               "destination_venue": "bithumb", "destination_address": "addr", "destination_network": "bitcoin",
               "destination_tag": "7", "route": "vpn", "on_behalf": "friend", "publishes_signal": True,
               "tags": frozenset({"spoof"}), "reservation_id": "R1"}
    assert set(changes) == {f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(model.Intent)}, "a new Intent field needs a case"
    for name, value in changes.items():

    _raises(ValueError, lambda: model.intent_hash(F.intent(quantity=math.nan)))


def test_seal_context_registers_and_hand_built_is_refused():
    sealed = F.ctx(active=model.ApprovedState.invalid("fixture"))
    assert model.is_sealed(sealed) and len(sealed.ctx_hash) == 64
    fields = {f.name: getattr(sealed, f.name) for f in dataclasses.fields(model.Context)}
    hand = model.Context(**fields)
    assert hand == sealed and not model.is_sealed(hand)                 # same fields, not sealed
    assert not model.is_sealed(dataclasses.replace(sealed, equity_krw=2.0))
    assert not model.is_sealed(None) and not model.is_sealed(object()) and not model.is_sealed(fields)
    again = model.seal_context(**fields)                               # a passed ctx_hash is ignored
    assert model.is_sealed(again) and again.ctx_hash == sealed.ctx_hash and again is not sealed
    changes = {"date": date(2026, 10, 24), "active": model.ApprovedState.invalid("other"),
               "snapshot": model.ApprovedState.invalid("s"), "owner": model.OwnerState.broken("x"),
               "code_hash": "d" * 64, "code_signed": False, "session": model.SessionState(), "equity_krw": 2.0,
```

```python
"""Shared types of the compliance gate (spec 6.1; plan decisions P2, P5): intents, approved state, owner state,
contexts, decisions, permits and screenings, plus the hashing helpers they rest on. Pure and standard library only,
so gate.py, owner.py and rules.py can all import it without a cycle."""
from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
import math
import weakref
import zoneinfo
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from core.compliance.rules import InstrumentMap, RulesTable, VenueFacts

ALLOW, ALLOW_EXIT, ACK_REQUIRED, BLOCK = "ALLOW", "ALLOW_EXIT", "ACK_REQUIRED", "BLOCK"
KST = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("Asia/Seoul")            # built at import; decide() never builds a zone


def jsonable(obj):
    """Plain JSON data for hashing: a dataclass becomes a dict of its fields, a Mapping a dict (tuple keys joined
    by "|"), a set a sorted list, a tuple a list, a date its ISO text. A non-finite float is ValueError; any other
    type is TypeError."""
    if obj is None or isinstance(obj, (str, bool, int)):
        return obj
    if isinstance(obj, float):
        if not math.isfinite(obj):
            raise ValueError(f"not a finite number: {obj!r}")
        return obj
    if isinstance(obj, date):
        return obj.isoformat()
    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(obj) and not isinstance(obj, type):
        return {f.name: jsonable(getattr(obj, f.name)) for f in dataclasses.fields(obj)}
    if isinstance(obj, Mapping):
        out = {}
        for key, value in obj.items():
            text = "|".join(str(part) for part in key) if isinstance(key, tuple) else str(key)
            if text in out:
                raise ValueError(f"two keys read as {text!r}")
            out[text] = jsonable(value)
        return out
    if isinstance(obj, (set, frozenset)):
        return sorted((jsonable(x) for x in obj), key=_sort_key)
    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
        return [jsonable(x) for x in obj]
    raise TypeError(f"not JSON data: {type(obj).__name__}")


def _sort_key(value) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)


def canonical_json(obj) -> str:
    """The same text as core.ficc.macro_schema.canonical_json, after jsonable(); NaN and inf refused."""
    return json.dumps(jsonable(obj), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)


def sha256_hex(data: bytes | str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(data, str) else data).hexdigest()


def iso_utc(moment: datetime) -> str:
    """An aware instant as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"; a naive one (or a bare date) is ValueError."""
    if not isinstance(moment, datetime) or moment.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"compliance: instants must be tz-aware, got {moment!r}")
    return moment.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Intent:
    """One order, transfer or plan leg as the caller sees it (spec 6.1); the class is derived, never supplied."""
    venue: str
    symbol: str
    counter_symbol: str = ""                      # P18: "" for transfer_out, lend and borrow
    asset: str
    multiple: float
    action: str
    financing: str = "cash"
    quantity: float
    notional_krw: float
    destination_venue: str | None = None
    destination_address: str | None = None
    destination_network: str | None = None
    destination_tag: str | None = None
    route: str = "direct"
    on_behalf: str = "self"
    publishes_signal: bool = False
    tags: frozenset = frozenset()
    reservation_id: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Exposure:
    held_krw: float                                                         # everything held there, settlement included
    reservations: Mapping[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)        # reservation_id -> notional_krw
    promised_sell_units: Mapping[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict) # symbol -> units promised to sell permits


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Positions:
    """Caller-supplied until the execution spec adds live reads (P19)."""
    equity_krw: float
    holdings: Mapping[tuple[str, str], float] = field(default_factory=dict)     # (venue, symbol) -> units
    shorts: Mapping[tuple[str, str], float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    exposure: Mapping[str, Exposure] = field(default_factory=dict)              # venue -> Exposure


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class ApprovedState:
    """The rules table, instrument map and venue facts in force, or `invalid(reason)`."""
    valid: bool
    reason: str = ""
    rules: RulesTable | None = None
    instruments: InstrumentMap | None = None
    venues: VenueFacts | None = None
    hashes: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)   # "rules" | "instruments" | "venues" -> sha256
    seq: int = 0                                              # largest owner-log seq among the approvals in force
    history_maps: tuple = ()                                  # earlier approved InstrumentMaps, newest first

    @classmethod
    def invalid(cls, reason: str) -> ApprovedState:
        return cls(valid=False, reason=reason)

    @property
    def state_hash(self) -> str:
        return sha256_hex(canonical_json({"hashes": self.hashes, "seq": self.seq})) if self.valid else ""


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class OwnerState:
    """What the verified owner log says (spec 6.4), or BROKEN: then every owner fact counts as absent."""
    status: str                                       # "OK" | "BROKEN"
    reason: str = ""
    head: tuple[int, str] = (0, "")                   # (seq, row_sha256) of the last line
    caps: Mapping[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    limits: Mapping[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    addresses: frozenset = frozenset()                # {(venue, symbol, network, address, tag or "")}
    flags: frozenset = frozenset()                    # met `requires.owner` items
    halted_floors: frozenset = frozenset()
    armed_sessions: frozenset = frozenset()
    session_acks: frozenset = frozenset()             # {(session_id, row_id, warning_sha256)}
    transfer_acks: frozenset = frozenset()            # {(intent_hash, warning_sha256)}
    fingerprint: str = ""

    @classmethod
    def broken(cls, reason: str, *, head=(0, ""), fingerprint="") -> OwnerState:
        return cls(status="BROKEN", reason=reason, head=head, fingerprint=fingerprint)

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == "OK"


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class SessionState:
    session_id: str | None = None
    armed: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Context:
    """Everything decide() may read. Only seal_context makes one that decide() accepts (P5)."""
    date: date                                        # Asia/Seoul date of the decision moment
    active: ApprovedState
    snapshot: ApprovedState | None
    owner: OwnerState
    code_hash: str
    code_signed: bool
    session: SessionState
    equity_krw: float
    holdings: Mapping[tuple[str, str], float]
    shorts: Mapping[tuple[str, str], float]
    exposure: Mapping[str, Exposure]
    ctx_hash: str = ""                                # set by seal_context


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Decision:
    """One verdict with its provenance (spec 6.1). decision_id is always derived from every other field."""
    verdict: str
    kind: str                                         # close_long | cover_short | withdraw | new_exposure | malformed
    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
    warnings: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    intent_hash: str
    state_hash: str
    code_hash: str
    owner_head: tuple[int, str]
    ctx_hash: str
    date: date | None
    decision_id: str = ""
    ack: tuple[str, str] | None = None                # (row_id, warning_sha256) when the verdict is ACK_REQUIRED

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        body = {f.name: getattr(self, f.name) for f in dataclasses.fields(self) if f.name != "decision_id"}
        object.__setattr__(self, "decision_id", sha256_hex(canonical_json(body)))


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Permit:
    decision_id: str
    intent_hash: str
    state_hash: str
    state_seq: int
    session_id: str | None
    reservation_id: str | None
    date: date


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Screening:
    decision: Decision
    allowed: bool                                     # verdict in (ALLOW, ACK_REQUIRED)
    flags: tuple[tuple[date, str, str], ...]          # (date, "review_by" | "auto_off" | "effective_until", row_id)
    exit_date: date | None
    screening_hash: str


def intent_hash(intent: Intent) -> str:
    return sha256_hex(canonical_json(intent))


_SEALED: weakref.WeakValueDictionary = weakref.WeakValueDictionary()     # id(ctx) -> ctx


def seal_context(**fields) -> Context:
    """Build a Context, hash every field into ctx_hash and register the instance (P5). Discipline, not
    security: owner.load_context and the test fixtures are its only callers."""
    fields.pop("ctx_hash", None)
    ctx = Context(**fields, ctx_hash=sha256_hex(canonical_json(fields)))
    _SEALED[id(ctx)] = ctx
    return ctx


def is_sealed(ctx) -> bool:
    return ctx is not None and _SEALED.get(id(ctx)) is ctx      # None would match a missing entry
```

  Notes for the implementer, not for the file:
  - `CANO` must never appear in core/ (test_09), so every mention is lower-case `canonical`.
  - `is_sealed` checks `ctx is not None` first: `WeakValueDictionary.get` returns None for a missing key, which
    `is None` would otherwise accept.
  - The `if TYPE_CHECKING:` import of `core.compliance.rules` is skipped by the P6 code closure and never runs, so
    rules.py may import model.py without a cycle.

### Task 7: decide(), steps 0-3 and 7, and the hard-coded floor (`core/compliance/gate.py`)

**Files:**
- Create: `core/compliance/gate.py` (LF, UTF-8, no BOM)
- Test: `tests/compliance_gate.py` (create; LF; Tasks 8 and 9 append to it)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 6 (`core.compliance.model`): `ALLOW, ALLOW_EXIT, ACK_REQUIRED, BLOCK`; `Intent`, `Exposure`, `ApprovedState`
    (`.valid`, `.reason`, `.rules`, `.instruments`, `.venues`, `.seq`, `.history_maps`, `.state_hash`), `OwnerState`
    (`.ok`, `.reason`, `.status`, `.head`, `.addresses`, `.broken(...)`), `Context`, `Decision`; `intent_hash`,
    `sha256_hex`, `is_sealed`, `seal_context` (tests only, through the fixture); fixtures `F.approved()`,
    `F.ctx(**overrides)`, `F.intent(**overrides)`.
  - Tasks 3-4 (`core.compliance.rules`): `VENUES`, `ASSETS`, `ACTIONS`, `TRADE_ACTIONS`, `FINANCING`, `TAGS`, `WHEN`,
    `DOMESTIC_EXCHANGES`, `PREDICTION_VENUES`, `STATE_BLOCKED`, `ASSET_CLASS`, `KNOWN_SPOT_CRYPTO_ETPS`;
    `RulesTable.rows`; `Row.id`, `.kind`, `.match` (`Mapping[str, frozenset]`), `.treatment`;
    `Instrument(section, symbol, asset, multiple, underlying, cls, cost_book, currency, tax_basis, source)`;
    `InstrumentMap.entries`, `InstrumentMap.lookup(sections, symbol) -> Instrument | None`; `Venue.id`,
    `.sections`, `.settlement`, `.deposits` (`{(symbol, network, tag_required)}`),
    `Venue.is_market(inst, counter) -> bool`; `VenueFacts.venues`.
  - Task 5 (shipped data the tests read through `F.approved()`): row `KR-KIS-KRX-SHARE` (venue, allow); the
    `kind: conduct` rows; symbols 005930, 252670 (-2), TQQQ (+3), SH (-1), IBIT, GDLC, EZPZ, BITO, BTC, USDT; venue
    facts for kis (sections krx, us; quote by currency; settlement KRW, USD), upbit (BTC-KRW; settlement KRW; deposits
    BTC on `bitcoin`, no tag), okx (BTC-USDT, BTC-USDC; settlement USDT, USDC) (P22).
- Produces (`core/compliance/gate.py`):
  - `decide(intent, ctx) -> Decision`: never raises; an internal exception gives BLOCK, kind `malformed`, reasons
    `("state: internal error <ExceptionType>",)`.
  - Floor constants of contract section 7, unchanged: `FLOOR_ALL_TAGS`, `FLOOR_ALL_ASSETS`, `FLOOR_NEW_VENUES`,
    `FLOOR_NEW_ASSETS`, `FLOOR_NEW_CLASSES`; private `_FLOOR_ALL_WHEN = rules.WHEN`, `_OKX_P2P`.
  - The step helpers with the contract signatures: `_choose_state`, `_validate`, `_conduct`, `_classify`,
    `_combine`; and `_exit`, `_new_exposure`, `_transfer`, which here **fail closed** (`BLOCK, ["no row"], []`,
    plus `None` for the ack) until **Task 8 replaces their bodies** (signatures and docstring first lines stay).
  - Private helpers Tasks 8 and 9 reuse instead of re-writing (exact signatures):
    `_matches(row, intent, cls) -> bool` (P12: every key of `row.match` must hold, AND across keys; `any` holds for
    everything; within one key any listed value is enough; `tag` = overlap with `intent.tags`; `when` = one listed
    predicate true; `class` compares the derived class passed as `cls`; other keys compare the intent field);
    `_floor_new(intent, inst) -> list[str]`; `_preconditions(ctx, state) -> list[str]`;
    `_positions(intent, ctx) -> list[str]`; `_credited(intent, ctx) -> bool`;
    `_lookup(state, venue, symbol, exits: bool) -> Instrument | None`; `_within_free(intent, ctx) -> bool`;
    `_units(book, intent) -> float`; `_why_no_active(ctx) -> str`; `_usable(state) -> bool`;
    `_tags(intent) -> frozenset`; `_when(intent) -> frozenset`; `_is(value, members) -> bool`;
    `_number(value) -> bool`; `_nonneg(value) -> bool`; `_ranked(reasons) -> tuple[str, ...]`;
    `_intent_hash(intent) -> str`;
    `_decision(intent, ctx, state, verdict, kind, reasons, warnings=(), ack=None) -> Decision`;
    `_fallback(intent, ctx, reason) -> Decision`; constants `_EXIT_KIND`, `_CLOSE_MANUALLY =
    "close manually in the broker app"`, `_WITHDRAW_MANUALLY = "withdraw manually in the exchange app"`, `_SLACK`.
  - Module-private names the rest of gate.py uses (listed for contract section 0; later tasks need not touch them):
    `_decide(intent, ctx) -> Decision` (the body that `decide()` wraps in its `try`); `_VERDICTS` (the four
    verdicts), `_RANKS` (the reason prefixes in severity order), `_TEXT` (the `Intent` fields that must be `str`),
    `_VOCAB` (`(field, vocabulary)` pairs), `_DESTINATION` (the four `destination_*` fields), `_NO_COUNTER`
    (`{"transfer_out", "lend", "borrow"}`, P18).
  - What `decide()` guarantees to the Task 8 bodies (the wiring is fixed here; Task 8 changes only the three bodies):
    - `_classify`, `_exit`, `_new_exposure` and `_transfer` are reached only with a sealed context, a usable state
      and an `Intent` that passed step 1, so `inst` and `venue` are not None and every field has the right type and
      vocabulary. (`_choose_state`, `_validate` and `_conduct` see every `Intent`, malformed ones included.)
    - `_exit(intent, ctx, state, kind, inst, venue)` is called for `kind` in `close_long`, `cover_short`, `withdraw`.
      `state` is `ctx.active` while `ctx.owner.ok` and the active state are usable, else the snapshot (D11). The
      snapshot can be the very object `ctx.active` is (the fixture `F.approved()` is cached), so "decided on the
      snapshot" is `not (ctx.owner.ok and _usable(ctx.active))`, never `state is not ctx.active` alone.
      Holdings, the registered address and the destination's deposit facts were already checked by `_classify`;
      under a broken owner log a domestic withdrawal still arrives as `withdraw`, and Task 8 must BLOCK it with
      `"withdraw manually in the exchange app"`. Its reasons are appended; conduct reasons already present make the
      result BLOCK whatever `_exit` returns.
    - `_new_exposure(intent, ctx, state, inst, venue)` is called only when `ctx.owner.ok`, `_usable(ctx.active)`,
      `state is ctx.active` and `ctx.code_signed is True` all hold (`_preconditions` tests all four; otherwise
      decide() has already added `"state: ..."` / `"unsigned code"` and skipped it). The new-exposure floor is
      already applied by decide() (`_floor_new`), so `_new_exposure` handles the venue rows, dates, stale rows,
      treatments, requires, grey caps, acks and `max_leverage` only.
    - `_transfer(...)` is called after `_new_exposure` for `action == "transfer_out"` only (a transfer that is not a
      withdraw exit).
    - The verdicts are combined by `_combine` with a BLOCK for any earlier reason; reasons are de-duplicated and
      ranked by `_ranked`; `Decision.ack` is the first non-None ack of the two calls, kept only when the final
      verdict is ACK_REQUIRED.
    - `Decision.state_hash` is the hash of the state actually used (the snapshot's for a snapshot exit; `""` when
      none was usable).
  - Reason strings produced here: `conduct: <tag | when-predicate | event_contract | sports_bet | conduct row id>`;
    `floor: <venue>`, `floor: <asset>`, `floor: etp_crypto_spot`, `floor: okx crypto_perp_or_future`,
    `floor: okx p2p_buy` / `p2p_sell`, `floor: option write`; `malformed: <intent field>` (and `malformed: intent`);
    `state: context not from load_context`, `state: owner log <reason>`, `state: <active state reason>`,
    `state: positions invalid (<names>)`, `state: internal error <type>`; `unsigned code`;
    `close manually in the broker app`; `withdraw manually in the exchange app`; `no row`.
  - gate.py binds no `date`, `datetime`, `time` or `ZoneInfo` name (Task 9's purity scan).

**Plan decisions used:** P5 (a context not from `seal_context` is BLOCK), P9 (symbols are looked up in the venue's
sections), P10/P11 (the class comes only from the map), P12 (match keys and their semantics, fixed in `_matches`),
P17 (conduct rows match every venue), P18 (`counter_symbol` rules), P19 (caller positions validated), P22 (deposit
facts drive withdraw classification).

Design notes (read before Step 3):
- Step 0 treats a broken owner log like an unusable active state: with `ctx.owner` BROKEN, exits use the snapshot
  and new exposure has no state at all (D11: "if owner state is corrupt, automated closing orders use the last
  approved stored snapshot").
- Step 1 runs without a state too: the intent's own fields, and the quantity tests, which read holdings and shorts
  from `ctx`, not from the state. A `sell` or `transfer_out` beyond holdings minus promised units, or a
  `buy_to_cover` beyond the short, is `malformed: quantity` whether or not a state is usable. An exit symbol
  missing from the map is looked up in `state.history_maps` (newest first); still missing adds
  `close manually in the broker app` (`withdraw manually ...` for a transfer).
- A vocabulary venue without approved venue facts (every venue except kis, upbit, bithumb, coinone, korbit, okx
  today: binance, gopax, hyperliquid, ibkr, ...) is `malformed: venue`. This is no new plan decision: spec 6.2
  step 1 makes a (`symbol`, `counter_symbol`) pair that is not a listed market of the venue malformed, a venue with
  no facts lists none, and P22 makes a venue without facts fail closed. The field is named `venue` because the
  venue's facts are what is missing. So the shipped rows for those venues (`KR-OFFSHORE-CEX`, `KR-GOPAX`,
  `KR-DEX`, `KR-IBKR`, ...) document the policy but never appear as reasons until the owner approves venue facts
  for them; the verdict comes from step 1 and the floor.
- The floor is applied to malformed intents too, so its reasons show even for venues that have no venue facts.
- Conduct rows apply whatever their dates (they only ever block). Caller positions (equity > 0; the intent's
  holdings, shorts and venue exposure finite and >= 0) are checked for every intent, exits included: corrupt
  positions block (fail closed).
- With no usable state an exit is BLOCK with the manual reason and keeps its kind (`close_long` or `cover_short` by
  action, `withdraw` for a `transfer_out` to a domestic exchange); new exposure, a `transfer_out` to any other venue
  included (spec 6.2 step 3), is BLOCK with the state reason.
- New exposure tests the owner log itself, not only state identity: the snapshot can be the very object
  `ctx.active` is, so `_preconditions` requires `ctx.owner.ok and _usable(ctx.active) and state is ctx.active`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

  Create `tests/compliance_gate.py` (LF). Nothing here asserts an ALLOW, because steps 4-6 fail closed until Task 8;
  every assertion is a BLOCK, a kind or a reason that stays true once Task 8 fills them in.

```python
"""decide() steps 0-3 and 7, and the hard-coded floor (Task 7; spec 5.2, 6.1, 6.2; compliance tests 3, 4, 5, 8).

Steps 4-6 fail closed until Task 8, so nothing here asserts an ALLOW: only BLOCKs, kinds and reasons that stay true
once Task 8 fills them in. Helpers are prefixed `_t7_` so that later tasks appending to this file cannot shadow them.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import math
import random

from core.compliance import gate, model, rules
from tests import compliance_fixtures as F

_T7_VERDICTS = (model.ALLOW, model.ALLOW_EXIT, model.ACK_REQUIRED, model.BLOCK)
_T7_OPTION = "AAPL261218C00300000"                     # fixture-only symbol; the shipped map has no option
_T7_ADDRESS = ("upbit", "BTC", "bitcoin", "bc1qfixtureaddress", "")
_T7_WHEN = {"route_not_direct": {"route": "vpn"}, "on_behalf_not_self": {"on_behalf": "follower"},
            "publishes_signal": {"publishes_signal": True}}


def _t7_kis(symbol: str, **changes) -> model.Intent:
    """A KIS buy of a shipped-map symbol, asset and multiple copied from the map."""
    state = F.approved()
    inst = state.instruments.lookup(state.venues.venues["kis"].sections, symbol)
    assert inst is not None, f"{symbol} is not in the shipped instrument map"
    return F.intent(**{"venue": "kis", "symbol": symbol, "counter_symbol": inst.currency, "asset": inst.asset,
                       "multiple": inst.multiple, "quantity": 1.0, "notional_krw": 70_000.0, **changes})


def _t7_option(**changes) -> model.Intent:
    return F.intent(**{"venue": "kis", "symbol": _T7_OPTION, "counter_symbol": "USD", "asset": "us_option",
                       "multiple": 1.0, "quantity": 1.0, "notional_krw": 20_000.0, **changes})


def _t7_with_option(state: model.ApprovedState) -> model.ApprovedState:
    """`state` with one fixture US option added to its map (the shipped map has none)."""
    option = rules.Instrument(section="us", symbol=_T7_OPTION, asset="us_option", multiple=1.0, underlying=None,
                              cls="option", cost_book=None, currency="USD", tax_basis="unsupported",
                              source="fixture: not a real listing")
    entries = {**state.instruments.entries, ("us", _T7_OPTION): option}
    return dataclasses.replace(state, instruments=dataclasses.replace(state.instruments, entries=entries))


def _t7_floor_only() -> model.ApprovedState:
    """The shipped state with every rules row deleted except one harmless allow row."""
    state = F.approved()
    keep = tuple(r for r in state.rules.rows if r.id == "KR-KIS-KRX-SHARE")
    assert len(keep) == 1 and keep[0].treatment == "allow" and keep[0].kind == "venue"
    return dataclasses.replace(state, rules=dataclasses.replace(state.rules, rows=keep))


def _t7_withdraw(**changes) -> model.Intent:
    """OKX -> Upbit BTC on the bitcoin network, to the address _t7_owner() registers."""
    return F.intent(**{"venue": "okx", "counter_symbol": "", "action": "transfer_out",
                       "destination_venue": "upbit", "destination_address": _T7_ADDRESS[3],
                       "destination_network": "bitcoin", **changes})


def _t7_owner(**changes) -> model.OwnerState:
    """The fixture owner (contract 5.4) with _T7_ADDRESS registered; any field can be replaced, addresses included."""
    return dataclasses.replace(F.ctx(active=model.ApprovedState.invalid("unused")).owner,
                               **{"addresses": frozenset({_T7_ADDRESS}), **changes})


def _t7_has(d: model.Decision, prefix: str) -> bool:
    return any(r.startswith(prefix) for r in d.reasons)


def test_hand_built_context_is_refused():
    sealed = F.ctx()
    hand = model.Context(**{f.name: getattr(sealed, f.name) for f in dataclasses.fields(model.Context)})
    for c in (hand, dataclasses.replace(sealed, code_signed=True), None, object(), "ctx"):
        d = gate.decide(F.intent(), c)
        assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and d.reasons == ("state: context not from load_context",), d
        assert (d.code_hash, d.ctx_hash, d.owner_head, d.date, d.state_hash) == ("", "", (0, ""), None, "")


def test_decision_records_provenance():
    c, i = F.ctx(), F.intent()
    d = gate.decide(i, c)
    assert d.intent_hash == model.intent_hash(i) and d.state_hash == c.active.state_hash != ""
    assert (d.code_hash, d.owner_head, d.ctx_hash, d.date) == (c.code_hash, c.owner.head, c.ctx_hash, c.date)
    assert d.kind == "new_exposure" and d.verdict in _T7_VERDICTS and len(d.decision_id) == 64
    assert gate.decide(i, c) == d                                        # deterministic
    assert d.ack is None or d.verdict == model.ACK_REQUIRED


def test_every_conduct_tag_and_predicate_blocks_exits_included():
    c = F.ctx(holdings={("upbit", "BTC"): 1.0, ("okx", "BTC"): 1.0}, shorts={("kis", "005930"): 10.0},
              owner=_t7_owner())
    bases = {"new_exposure": F.intent(), "close_long": F.intent(action="sell"),
             "cover_short": _t7_kis("005930", action="buy_to_cover"), "withdraw": _t7_withdraw()}
    cases = [({"tags": frozenset({t})}, f"conduct: {t}") for t in sorted(rules.TAGS)]
    cases += [(change, f"conduct: {name}") for name, change in sorted(_T7_WHEN.items())]
    for kind, base in bases.items():
        clean = gate.decide(base, c)
        assert clean.kind == kind and not _t7_has(clean, "conduct: "), (kind, clean.reasons)
        for change, reason in cases:
            d = gate.decide(dataclasses.replace(base, **change), c)
            assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and d.kind == kind and reason in d.reasons, (kind, change, d.reasons)
    for asset in sorted(gate.FLOOR_ALL_ASSETS):                          # malformed here, and still conduct
        d = gate.decide(F.intent(action="sell", asset=asset), c)
        assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and f"conduct: {asset}" in d.reasons, d.reasons


def test_shipped_conduct_rows_each_fire():
    rows = [r for r in F.approved().rules.rows if r.kind == "conduct"]
    assert rows, "the shipped table has no conduct rows"
    c = F.ctx()
    for row in rows:
        fields = {}
        for key, allowed in sorted(row.match.items()):
            values = sorted(allowed - {"any"})
            if not values:
                continue
            if key == "tag":
                fields["tags"] = frozenset(values[:1])
            elif key == "when":
                fields.update(_T7_WHEN[values[0]])
            elif key == "class":
                assets = sorted(a for a, cls in rules.ASSET_CLASS.items() if cls in allowed)
                assert assets, f"{row.id}: a conduct row keyed on an ETP class never fires (gate._conduct)"
                fields["asset"] = assets[0]
            else:
                fields[key] = values[0]
        d = gate.decide(F.intent(**fields), c)
        assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and f"conduct: {row.id}" in d.reasons, (row.id, fields, d.reasons)


def test_floor_blocks_with_the_table_rows_deleted():
    state = _t7_floor_only()
    c = F.ctx(active=state, holdings={("kis", "IBIT"): 2.0, ("upbit", "BTC"): 1.0})
    for change, reason in [({"tags": frozenset({"spoof"})}, "conduct: spoof"),
                           ({"route": "vpn"}, "conduct: route_not_direct"),
                           ({"asset": "event_contract"}, "conduct: event_contract"),
                           ({"asset": "sports_bet"}, "conduct: sports_bet")]:
        for base in (F.intent(), F.intent(action="sell")):                     # new exposure and an exit
            d = gate.decide(dataclasses.replace(base, **change), c)
            assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and reason in d.reasons, (change, d.reasons)
    cases = [(F.intent(venue=v, counter_symbol="USDT"), f"floor: {v}") for v in sorted(gate.FLOOR_NEW_VENUES)]
    cases += [(F.intent(venue="okx", counter_symbol="USDT", asset="crypto_perp_or_future"),
               "floor: okx crypto_perp_or_future"),
              (F.intent(venue="okx", counter_symbol="USDT", action="p2p_buy"), "floor: okx p2p_buy"),
              (F.intent(venue="okx", counter_symbol="USDT", action="p2p_sell"), "floor: okx p2p_sell"),
              (_t7_withdraw(venue="upbit", destination_venue="polymarket"), "floor: polymarket")]
    kis = state.venues.venues["kis"]
    spot = [s for s in sorted(rules.KNOWN_SPOT_CRYPTO_ETPS) if state.instruments.lookup(kis.sections, s)]
    assert {"IBIT", "GDLC", "EZPZ"} <= set(spot), spot
    cases += [(_t7_kis(s), "floor: etp_crypto_spot") for s in spot]
    cases += [(_t7_kis("005930", asset=a), f"floor: {a}") for a in sorted(gate.FLOOR_NEW_ASSETS)]
    for i, reason in cases:
        d = gate.decide(i, c)
        assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and reason in d.reasons, (i, d.reasons)
    write = gate.decide(_t7_option(action="write"), F.ctx(active=_t7_with_option(state)))
    assert write.verdict == model.BLOCK and write.kind == "new_exposure" and "floor: option write" in write.reasons
    sell = gate.decide(_t7_kis("IBIT", action="sell"), c)                   # a held IBIT can still be sold (D11)
    assert sell.kind == "close_long" and not _t7_has(sell, "floor: "), sell.reasons


def test_classification_goes_through_the_map():
    state, c = F.approved(), F.ctx()
    expected = {"TQQQ": "etp_leveraged", "252670": "etp_leveraged", "SH": "etp_index_inverse",
                "IBIT": "etp_crypto_spot", "GDLC": "etp_crypto_spot", "BITO": "etp_crypto_futures_1x"}
    for symbol, cls in expected.items():
        i = _t7_kis(symbol)
        inst, venue, bad = gate._validate(i, c, state)
        assert bad == [] and inst.cls == cls and venue.id == "kis", (symbol, bad)
        wrong = gate.decide(dataclasses.replace(i, multiple=i.multiple + 1.0), c)
        assert wrong.verdict == model.BLOCK and "malformed: multiple" in wrong.reasons, (symbol, wrong.reasons)
    assert (_t7_kis("252670").multiple, _t7_kis("TQQQ").multiple, _t7_kis("SH").multiple) == (-2.0, 3.0, -1.0)
    assert not _t7_has(gate.decide(_t7_kis("BITO"), c), "floor: ")
    assert "class" not in {f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(model.Intent)}     # the caller never supplies it
    lev = next(r for r in state.rules.rows if r.id == "KR-KIS-ETP-LEV")         # P12: `class` is the derived one
    assert gate._matches(lev, _t7_kis("TQQQ"), "etp_leveraged") and not gate._matches(lev, _t7_kis("SPY"), "etp_1x")
    swap = F.intent(venue="okx", symbol="USDT", counter_symbol="BTC", action="sell")   # (USDT, BTC) is no okx market
    d = gate.decide(swap, F.ctx(holdings={("okx", "USDT"): 100.0}))
    assert d.kind == "malformed" and "malformed: counter_symbol" in d.reasons, d.reasons
    okx = state.venues.venues["okx"]
    wide = dataclasses.replace(okx, markets=okx.markets | {("USDT", "USDC")})    # a fixture-only market
    venues = dataclasses.replace(state.venues, venues={**state.venues.venues, "okx": wide})
    listed = F.ctx(active=dataclasses.replace(state, venues=venues), holdings={("okx", "USDT"): 100.0})
    settle = gate.decide(F.intent(venue="okx", symbol="USDT", counter_symbol="USDC", action="sell"), listed)
    assert settle.kind == "new_exposure", settle.reasons                   # a settlement asset sold: no close_long


def test_credit_lend_and_borrow_block():
    # D15. Steps 4-6 fail closed until Task 8, so the BLOCK here only shows the intents are well formed. The row
    # matches are pinned directly; Task 8 asserts the reasons "out_of_scope: KR-KIS-CREDIT" and
    # "out_of_scope: KR-DOMESTIC-LENDING".
    rows = {r.id: r for r in F.approved().rules.rows}
    c = F.ctx(holdings={("upbit", "BTC"): 1.0})
    credit = _t7_kis("005930", financing="credit")
    d = gate.decide(credit, c)
    assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and d.kind == "new_exposure", d.reasons
    assert gate._matches(rows["KR-KIS-CREDIT"], credit, "share")
    assert not gate._matches(rows["KR-KIS-CREDIT"], _t7_kis("005930"), "share")    # cash is not credit
    for action in ("lend", "borrow"):
        i = F.intent(action=action, counter_symbol="")
        d = gate.decide(i, c)
        assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and d.kind == "new_exposure", (action, d.reasons)
        assert gate._matches(rows["KR-DOMESTIC-LENDING"], i, "coin"), action
    assert not gate._matches(rows["KR-DOMESTIC-LENDING"], F.intent(), "coin")      # a buy is not lending


def test_fail_closed_inputs_are_malformed():
    c = F.ctx(active=_t7_with_option(F.approved()), holdings={("upbit", "BTC"): 0.003, ("kis", "IBIT"): 1.0},
              shorts={("kis", "005930"): 1.0},

    w = _t7_withdraw(venue="upbit", destination_venue="bithumb")
    cases = [
        (F.intent(quantity=math.nan), "quantity"), (F.intent(quantity=math.inf), "quantity"),
        (F.intent(quantity=-0.001), "quantity"), (F.intent(quantity=0.0), "quantity"),
        (F.intent(quantity="0.001"), "quantity"), (F.intent(quantity=True), "quantity"),
        (F.intent(notional_krw=math.inf), "notional_krw"), (F.intent(notional_krw=-1.0), "notional_krw"),
        (F.intent(notional_krw=math.nan), "notional_krw"), (F.intent(multiple=math.nan), "multiple"),
        (F.intent(venue=5), "venue"), (F.intent(venue="UPBIT"), "venue"), (F.intent(symbol="btc"), "symbol"),
        (F.intent(symbol="DOGE"), "symbol"), (F.intent(asset="Crypto_coin"), "asset"),
        (F.intent(action="BUY"), "action"), (F.intent(financing="loan"), "financing"),
        (F.intent(publishes_signal="no"), "publishes_signal"), (F.intent(tags=frozenset({"pump"})), "tags"),
        (F.intent(tags=["spoof"]), "tags"), (F.intent(reservation_id=""), "reservation_id"),
        (F.intent(destination_venue="bithumb"), "destination_venue"),
        (F.intent(destination_address="bc1q"), "destination_address"),
        (dataclasses.replace(w, destination_address=None), "destination_address"),
        (dataclasses.replace(w, destination_network=""), "destination_network"),
        (dataclasses.replace(w, destination_tag=""), "destination_tag"),
        (dataclasses.replace(w, destination_venue="upbit"), "destination_venue"),
        (dataclasses.replace(w, destination_venue="Bithumb"), "destination_venue"),
        (dataclasses.replace(w, counter_symbol="KRW"), "counter_symbol"),
        (F.intent(counter_symbol="USDT"), "counter_symbol"), (F.intent(counter_symbol=""), "counter_symbol"),
        (_t7_kis("TQQQ", counter_symbol="KRW"), "counter_symbol"), (F.intent(action="lend"), "counter_symbol"),
        (F.intent(action="sell", quantity=0.004), "quantity"),               # beyond holdings
        (F.intent(action="sell", quantity=0.002), "quantity"),               # within holdings, beyond promised
        (dataclasses.replace(w, quantity=0.002), "quantity"),
        (_t7_option(action="sell"), "quantity"),                             # an option sell with no holding
        (_t7_kis("005930", action="buy_to_cover", quantity=2.0), "quantity"),   # beyond the short
        (F.intent(asset="us_etp"), "asset"), (_t7_kis("TQQQ", multiple=1.0), "multiple"),
    ]
    for i, field in cases:

            (i, d.reasons)
    ok = gate.decide(F.intent(action="sell", quantity=0.001), c)            # exactly the free units
    assert ok.kind == "close_long" and not _t7_has(ok, "malformed: "), ok.reasons
    assert gate.decide(w, c).kind != "malformed"

             (F.ctx(exposure={"upbit": model.Exposure(held_krw=0.0, reservations={"R": -5.0})}), F.intent(),

def test_new_exposure_needs_active_owner_and_signed_code():
    held = {("upbit", "BTC"): 1.0}
    for c, reason in ((F.ctx(active=model.ApprovedState.invalid("rules: unapproved")), "state: rules: unapproved"),
                      (F.ctx(owner=model.OwnerState.broken("no owner key yet: owner act 1")),
                       "state: owner log no owner key yet: owner act 1"),
                      (F.ctx(code_signed=False, holdings=held), "unsigned code")):
        d = gate.decide(F.intent(), c)
        assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and d.kind == "new_exposure" and reason in d.reasons, d.reasons
    sell = gate.decide(F.intent(action="sell"), F.ctx(code_signed=False, holdings=held))
    assert sell.kind == "close_long" and "unsigned code" not in sell.reasons      # exits ignore code_signed


def test_no_usable_state_sends_exits_to_the_app():
    held = {("upbit", "BTC"): 1.0, ("okx", "BTC"): 1.0}
    dead = model.ApprovedState.invalid("owner log broken")
    c = F.ctx(active=dead, holdings=held, owner=_t7_owner())
    sell = gate.decide(F.intent(action="sell"), c)
    assert sell.verdict == model.BLOCK and sell.kind == "close_long"
    assert "close manually in the broker app" in sell.reasons
    w = gate.decide(_t7_withdraw(), c)
    assert w.verdict == model.BLOCK and w.kind == "withdraw" and "withdraw manually in the exchange app" in w.reasons
    for dest in ("okx", "binance"):                                       # step 3: an offshore deposit is no exit
        t = gate.decide(_t7_withdraw(venue="upbit", destination_venue=dest), c)
        assert t.verdict == model.BLOCK and t.kind == "new_exposure", (dest, t.reasons)
        assert "state: owner log broken" in t.reasons and "withdraw manually in the exchange app" not in t.reasons
    over = gate.decide(F.intent(action="sell", quantity=5.0), c)          # holdings come from ctx: still step 1
    assert over.kind == "malformed" and "malformed: quantity" in over.reasons, over.reasons
    snap = F.ctx(active=dead, snapshot=F.approved(), holdings=held, owner=_t7_owner())
    d = gate.decide(F.intent(action="sell"), snap)
    assert d.kind == "close_long" and d.state_hash == F.approved().state_hash, d
    assert "close manually in the broker app" not in d.reasons
    buy = gate.decide(F.intent(), snap)                                   # the snapshot never serves new exposure
    assert buy.verdict == model.BLOCK and "state: owner log broken" in buy.reasons and buy.state_hash == ""
    snap2 = F.approved(seq=2)                                             # a snapshot distinct from the active state
    broken = F.ctx(owner=model.OwnerState.broken("bad signature on entry 4"), snapshot=snap2, holdings=held)
    d = gate.decide(F.intent(action="sell"), broken)                      # a broken log means the snapshot (D11)
    assert d.kind == "close_long" and d.state_hash == snap2.state_hash != broken.active.state_hash
    same = F.ctx(owner=model.OwnerState.broken("bad signature"), snapshot=F.approved(), holdings=held)
    t = gate.decide(_t7_withdraw(venue="upbit", destination_venue="okx"), same)   # the snapshot IS ctx.active here
    assert t.kind == "new_exposure" and "state: owner log bad signature" in t.reasons, t.reasons


def test_withdraw_classification():
    held = {("okx", "BTC"): 0.01}
    lightning = ("upbit", "BTC", "lightning", _T7_ADDRESS[3], "")          # registered, but upbit credits bitcoin only
    tagged = ("upbit", "BTC", "bitcoin", _T7_ADDRESS[3], "123")            # registered, but upbit takes no tag
    c = F.ctx(holdings=held, owner=_t7_owner(addresses=frozenset({_T7_ADDRESS, lightning, tagged})))
    w = _t7_withdraw()
    assert gate.decide(w, c).kind == "withdraw"
    for change in ({"destination_network": "lightning"}, {"destination_address": "bc1qother"},
                   {"destination_tag": "123"}, {"destination_venue": "bithumb"}, {"destination_venue": "binance"}):
        assert gate.decide(dataclasses.replace(w, **change), c).kind == "new_exposure", change
    assert gate.decide(w, F.ctx(holdings=held)).kind == "new_exposure"      # no registered address
    okx_addr = ("okx", "BTC", "bitcoin", "bc1qokx", "")
    into_okx = F.ctx(holdings={("upbit", "BTC"): 1.0}, owner=_t7_owner(addresses=frozenset({okx_addr})))
    t = _t7_withdraw(venue="upbit", destination_venue="okx", destination_address="bc1qokx")
    assert gate.decide(t, into_okx).kind == "new_exposure"               # okx credits it, but is not domestic
    broken = F.ctx(holdings=held, owner=model.OwnerState.broken("bad signature on entry 4"), snapshot=F.approved())
    d = gate.decide(w, broken)
    assert d.kind == "withdraw" and d.verdict == model.BLOCK, d.reasons


def test_history_maps_serve_exits_only():
    full = F.approved()
    entries = {k: v for k, v in full.instruments.entries.items() if k != ("us", "IBIT")}
    state = dataclasses.replace(full, instruments=dataclasses.replace(full.instruments, entries=entries),
                                history_maps=(full.instruments,))
    held = {("kis", "IBIT"): 2.0}
    sell = gate.decide(_t7_kis("IBIT", action="sell"), F.ctx(active=state, holdings=held))
    assert sell.kind == "close_long" and not _t7_has(sell, "malformed: "), sell.reasons
    buy = gate.decide(_t7_kis("IBIT"), F.ctx(active=state, holdings=held))
    assert buy.kind == "malformed" and "malformed: symbol" in buy.reasons
    gone = F.ctx(active=dataclasses.replace(state, history_maps=()), holdings=held)
    d = gate.decide(_t7_kis("IBIT", action="sell"), gone)
    assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and {"malformed: symbol", "close manually in the broker app"} <= set(d.reasons)


def test_reasons_ranked_and_verdicts_combined():
    assert gate._ranked(["ack required: KR-OKX-SPOT", "no row", "state: x", "malformed: venue", "floor: okx p2p_buy",
                         "conduct: spoof", "unsigned code", "no row", "hard_block: KR-PREDICTION"]) == (
        "conduct: spoof", "floor: okx p2p_buy", "malformed: venue", "state: x", "unsigned code", "no row",
        "hard_block: KR-PREDICTION", "ack required: KR-OKX-SPOT")
    A, X, K, B = model.ALLOW, model.ALLOW_EXIT, model.ACK_REQUIRED, model.BLOCK
    for verdicts, want in (([], B), ([A], A), ([X], X), ([A, K], K), ([X, B], B), ([K, B, A], B), (["bogus"], B),
                           ([A, "ALLOW "], B)):
        assert gate._combine(verdicts) == want, verdicts
    d = gate.decide(F.intent(venue="polymarket", asset="event_contract", counter_symbol="USDC",
                             tags=frozenset({"spoof"})), F.ctx())
    assert d.reasons[0].startswith("conduct: ") and d.reasons.index("floor: polymarket") < \
        d.reasons.index("malformed: venue"), d.reasons

def test_fuzzed_intents_never_raise():
    rng = random.Random(23)
    junk = (None, [], ["upbit"], {"a": 1}, (), 0, -1, 1.5, 1e308, -1e308, math.nan, math.inf, -math.inf, True, "",
            "UPBIT", 10 ** 30, b"x", object(), frozenset({1}), set(), frozenset({"spoof"}))
    good = {"venue": sorted(rules.VENUES), "symbol": ["BTC", "USDT", "USDC", "005930", "TQQQ", "IBIT", "DOGE"],
            "counter_symbol": ["", "KRW", "USD", "USDT", "BTC"], "asset": sorted(rules.ASSETS),
            "multiple": [1.0, -1.0, 2.0, 3.0, -2.0, 1], "action": sorted(rules.ACTIONS),
            "financing": sorted(rules.FINANCING), "quantity": [0.001, 1.0, 1e308], "notional_krw": [0.0, 5e4, 1e308],
            "destination_venue": [None, "upbit", "okx", "bithumb"], "destination_address": [None, _T7_ADDRESS[3]],
            "destination_network": [None, "bitcoin"], "destination_tag": [None, "7"], "route": ["direct", "vpn"],
            "on_behalf": ["self", "follower"], "publishes_signal": [False, True],
            "tags": [frozenset(), frozenset({"spoof"})], "reservation_id": [None, "R1"]}
    held = {("upbit", "BTC"): 1.0, ("okx", "BTC"): 1.0, ("kis", "IBIT"): 1.0}
    contexts = [F.ctx(holdings=held, shorts={("kis", "005930"): 1.0}, owner=_t7_owner()),
                F.ctx(active=model.ApprovedState.invalid("fixture"), snapshot=F.approved(), holdings=held)]
    for n in range(5000):
        fields = {k: (rng.choice(v) if rng.random() < 0.7 else rng.choice(junk)) for k, v in good.items()}
        c = contexts[n % 2] if n % 50 else rng.choice((None, object(), "ctx"))
        try:
            d = gate.decide(model.Intent(**fields), c)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise AssertionError(f"Random(23) case {n}: decide raised {exc!r} on {fields}") from exc
        assert type(d) is model.Decision and d.verdict in _T7_VERDICTS and (d.verdict != model.BLOCK or d.reasons), \
            (n, fields, d)
    for odd in (None, 5, "intent", vars(F.intent()), [F.intent()]):
        assert gate.decide(odd, contexts[0]).reasons == ("malformed: intent",)


def test_property_conduct_intents_always_block():
    rng = random.Random(23)
    state = F.approved()
    keys = sorted(state.instruments.entries)
    venues_for = {"krx": ["kis"], "us": ["kis"], "crypto": ["upbit", "okx", "bithumb", "coinone", "korbit"]}
    quote = {"kis": None, "upbit": "KRW", "bithumb": "KRW", "coinone": "KRW", "korbit": "KRW", "okx": "USDT"}
    every = {(v, s): 1.0 for v in sorted(rules.VENUES) for _, s in keys}
    c = F.ctx(holdings=every, shorts=every, owner=_t7_owner())
    kinds = set()
    for n in range(2000):
        action = rng.choice(sorted(rules.ACTIONS))
        key = ("crypto", "BTC") if action == "transfer_out" else rng.choice(keys)    # transfers move coins
        inst = state.instruments.entries[key]
        realistic = rng.random() < 0.7
        venue = rng.choice(venues_for[inst.section]) if realistic else rng.choice(sorted(rules.VENUES))
        counter = "" if action in ("transfer_out", "lend", "borrow") else \
            (quote.get(venue) or inst.currency) if realistic else rng.choice(["KRW", "USD", "USDT", "BTC"])
        conduct = rng.choice(("tag", "route", "on_behalf", "signal"))
        fields = dict(venue=venue, symbol=inst.symbol, counter_symbol=counter,
                      asset=inst.asset if realistic else rng.choice(sorted(rules.ASSETS)),
                      multiple=inst.multiple if realistic else rng.choice([1.0, -1.0, 2.0, 3.0]), action=action,
                      financing=rng.choice(sorted(rules.FINANCING)) if rng.random() < 0.2 else "cash",
                      quantity=rng.choice([0.001, 0.5, 1.0]), notional_krw=rng.choice([0.0, 5_000.0, 50_000.0]),
                      tags=frozenset(rng.sample(sorted(rules.TAGS), rng.randint(1, 3))) if conduct == "tag"
                      else frozenset(),
                      route="vpn" if conduct == "route" else "direct",
                      on_behalf="follower" if conduct == "on_behalf" else "self",
                      publishes_signal=conduct == "signal")
        if action == "transfer_out":
            fields.update(destination_venue=rng.choice(["upbit", "upbit", "bithumb", "okx"]),
                          destination_address=_T7_ADDRESS[3], destination_network="bitcoin")
        d = gate.decide(model.Intent(**fields), c)
        assert d.verdict == model.BLOCK and _t7_has(d, "conduct: "), (f"Random(23) case {n}", fields, d.reasons)
        kinds.add(d.kind)
    assert kinds == {"close_long", "cover_short", "withdraw", "new_exposure", "malformed"}, kinds
```
